questions.q: How does trajectory tracking differ from path following?
options: It doesn't; in control theory they are synonyms
A trajectory can only be a straight line
You also have to be at the point on time
A path is defined by splines only
questions.explain: A trajectory is a path with time; it matters for formation flight and synchronized maneuvers.

questions.q: What is the lateral acceleration in the pure pursuit law?
options: a = V·sin α
a = 2V²·sin α / L
a = L·sin α / V²
a = V² / L, no angle
questions.explain: The curvature of the arc to the lookahead point is κ = 2 sin α / L, and a = V²κ.

questions.q: What does too short a lookahead distance L cause?
options: A slow, smooth approach to the path line
Cutting the corners of the route
A drop in the vehicle's speed
Overshoot and sensitivity to noise
questions.explain: Small L: aggressive commands, overshoot; large L: slow, and corners get cut.

questions.q: L1 at V = 18 m/s, NAVL1_PERIOD = 17, NAVL1_DAMPING = 0.75?
options: about 73 m
about 230 m
about 13 m

questions.q: Why is a trapezoidal profile bad for a copter?
options: It is noticeably slower than any S-curve
Acceleration steps are tilt steps
It does not limit the speed
It does not work in AUTO mode
questions.explain: The jerk is infinite: jerky motion, a swinging payload and camera.

questions.q: What does the S-curve pay for smoothness in the 50 m example?
options: Twice the speed
A 2 m overshoot at the end
Higher jerk consumption
An extra 0.5 s of time
questions.explain: Ramping the acceleration at bounded jerk adds time: 7.5 s versus 7.0.

questions.q: Why is it snap that gets minimized for a quadrotor?
options: Motor torques are tied to snap
Snap is the second derivative, easier to compute
It makes the path shorter
Snap does not affect the motors
questions.explain: Thrust ~ acceleration, angular velocity ~ jerk, roll/pitch torques ~ snap (the fourth derivative).

questions.q: Why does the companion send velocity and acceleration along with position?
options: Position is not accepted without them
To reduce the load on the link
So the controller does not lag
It is needed only for planes
questions.explain: Feedforward: the position controller only has to close the remaining error.
